speaker: James G. O. Fantone
title: Take Upon Us His Name
summary: Elder Fantone teaches that taking upon us the name of Jesus Christ is not adding His name to ours like a badge, but covenanting to serve Him by serving others. He tells of mistakenly signing his own name on his daughter's school form, of parents who gave up their children's bedrooms to a student and a struggling family, and of homesick missionaries who were changed by serving. He asks members to take Christ's name by covenant and lose themselves in serving others, promising that they will find Him and find themselves.
